import { ref } from 'vue';
import { Howl, getPcmContext, isAudioArmed } from '@/lib/audioRuntime';
import { logTelemetry } from '@/lib/telemetry';

/**
 * Queue-based audio player for streaming TTS audio chunks.
 *
 * Supports two playback modes:
 *
 * 1. **Queue mode** (Groq/OpenAI): Each chunk is an independently-synthesized audio file.
 *    Converted to blob URLs and played sequentially via Howler.js.
 *
 * 2. **Stream mode** (ElevenLabs/Qwen/Fish): Chunks are raw PCM or standalone PCM16 WAV
 *    files. Each is scheduled as an AudioBuffer on a running playhead via the Web Audio
 *    API — gapless, and (unlike MSE+MP3) playable on Safari and iOS.
 *
 * Audio plays only after `armAudio()` has run in an audio gesture on this page.
 * Before that, synthesis state and incoming chunks are dropped: a TTS event from
 * a stream or broadcast must never be what activates the device's audio session.
 */
export function useWebAudioPlayer(options?: { onFirstPlay?: () => void; onGap?: () => void }) {
  const isPlaying = ref(false);
  const isSynthesizing = ref(false);

  // Mutable callback reference — allows setOnFirstPlay() to update after construction
  let onFirstPlayCallback = options?.onFirstPlay;
  // Fires when the gap watchdog trips: playback has genuinely stalled (chunks buffered
  // but the head chunk never arrived for 10s). This is the ONLY real "something's wrong"
  // moment worth an audible cue — a backend retry that self-heals is not.
  let onGapCallback = options?.onGap;

  // --- Queue mode state (Groq/OpenAI) ---
  // Howls are created lazily at play time — only ONE <audio> element exists at once.
  // Eagerly creating Howls per chunk caused iOS Safari to throttle/refuse concurrent loads.
  let currentHowl: Howl | null = null;
  let currentBlobUrl: string | null = null;
  const queue: Array<{ blobUrl: string; format: string; isExternalUrl?: boolean }> = [];
  let isPlayingNext = false;
  let hasPlayedFirst = false;
  let currentIsExternalUrl = false;

  // --- Ordered chunk buffering (for WebSocket TTS where delivery may be out-of-order) ---
  let expectedNextIndex = 0;
  const chunkBuffer = new Map<number, { url: string; format: string; isFinal: boolean }>();

  // Gap-skip watchdog: if expectedNextIndex hasn't advanced for 10s while higher chunks
  // are buffered, skip the missing chunk(s) and flush from the lowest buffered index.
  let gapWatchdogTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  function clearGapWatchdog(): void {
    if (gapWatchdogTimer) {
      clearTimeout(gapWatchdogTimer);
      gapWatchdogTimer = null;
    }
  }

  function startGapWatchdog(): void {
    if (gapWatchdogTimer) return; // Already running
    gapWatchdogTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      gapWatchdogTimer = null;
      if (chunkBuffer.size === 0) return;

      // Find the lowest buffered index and skip to it
      const lowestBuffered = Math.min(...chunkBuffer.keys());
      const skippedIndices = [];
      for (let i = expectedNextIndex; i < lowestBuffered; i++) {
        skippedIndices.push(i);
      }
      console.warn(
        `[useWebAudioPlayer] Gap watchdog: skipping chunk(s) ${skippedIndices.join(', ')}, jumping to ${lowestBuffered}`
      );
      logTelemetry(
        'TTS gap watchdog: chunks skipped',
        {
          skipped_indices: skippedIndices,
          jumped_to: lowestBuffered,
          buffer_size: chunkBuffer.size,
        },
        'error'
      );

      // A real audible stall — surface the single sanctioned audible cue.
      onGapCallback?.();

      expectedNextIndex = lowestBuffered;

      // Flush consecutive chunks from the new starting point
      while (chunkBuffer.has(expectedNextIndex)) {
        const chunk = chunkBuffer.get(expectedNextIndex)!;
        chunkBuffer.delete(expectedNextIndex);

        if (chunk.url) {
          queueUrl(chunk.url, chunk.format);
        }

        if (chunk.isFinal) {
          isSynthesizing.value = false;
        }

        expectedNextIndex++;
      }

      // If there are still buffered chunks with gaps, restart the watchdog
      if (chunkBuffer.size > 0) {
        startGapWatchdog();
      }
    }, 10000);
  }

  // --- Playback watchdog (detects missed Howler onend events) ---
  let playbackWatchdog: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  let howlCreatedAt = 0; // timestamp of current Howl creation for grace period

  function clearPlaybackWatchdog(): void {
    if (playbackWatchdog) {
      clearInterval(playbackWatchdog);
      playbackWatchdog = null;
    }
  }

  // --- Stream mode state (ElevenLabs PCM / Qwen/Fish WAV via Web Audio scheduling) ---
  // Both providers ultimately yield mono 16-bit PCM. We schedule each chunk as an AudioBuffer
  // on a running playhead (Web Audio API) — gapless, and works on every browser
  // including Safari/iOS, which cannot MSE-decode MP3. The context comes from
  // `getPcmContext()`, created and resumed by `armAudio()` inside the gesture.
  let streamCtx: AudioContext | null = null;
  let streamSampleRate = 24000;
  let nextPlayTime = 0;
  let scheduledSources: AudioBufferSourceNode[] = [];
  let pendingScheduled = 0;
  let streamEnded = false;
  let streamInitialBufferSeconds = 0;
  let streamBufferedBeforeStart = 0;
  let streamHasStarted = false;
  let streamPendingBuffers: AudioBuffer[] = [];
  let streamGeneration = 0;
  let streamUrlChain: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
  let streamUsesUrls = false;

  let loggedUnarmedDrop = false;

  /** False (and logged once) while no audio gesture has armed this page. */
  function acceptsAudio(): boolean {
    if (isAudioArmed()) return true;
    if (!loggedUnarmedDrop) {
      loggedUnarmedDrop = true;
      logTelemetry('TTS audio dropped: page not armed by an audio gesture', {});
    }
    return false;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Queue mode (Groq/OpenAI) — each chunk is a complete audio file
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * Decode base64 audio and queue the blob URL for playback.
   * Howls are NOT created here — only when playNext() dequeues the entry.
   * This ensures only one <audio> element exists at a time (iOS Safari
   * throttles/refuses concurrent audio element loads).
   */
  async function queueChunk(base64Audio: string, format: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!acceptsAudio()) return;
    try {
      const binaryString = atob(base64Audio);
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
        bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
      }

      const mimeType = getMimeType(format);
      const blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: mimeType });
      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

      queue.push({ blobUrl, format });

      // Start playing if not already
      if (!isPlayingNext) {
        playNext();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[useWebAudioPlayer] Failed to decode audio chunk:', e);
      logTelemetry(
        'TTS audio chunk decode failed',
        {
          format,
          error: String(e),
        },
        'error'
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Queue an external URL (e.g. S3 pre-signed) for playback.
   * Unlike queueChunk, no base64 decoding or blob creation needed.
   */
  function queueUrl(url: string, format: string): void {
    if (!acceptsAudio()) return;
    queue.push({ blobUrl: url, format, isExternalUrl: true });
    if (!isPlayingNext) {
      playNext();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Release the current Howl's <audio> element and revoke its blob URL.
   */
  function cleanupCurrentHowl(): void {
    clearPlaybackWatchdog();
    if (currentHowl) {
      currentHowl.unload();
      currentHowl = null;
    }
    if (currentBlobUrl && !currentIsExternalUrl) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(currentBlobUrl);
    }
    currentBlobUrl = null;
    currentIsExternalUrl = false;
  }

  function playNext(): void {
    if (queue.length === 0) {
      isPlayingNext = false;
      // Only mark as not playing if synthesis is also done
      if (!isSynthesizing.value) {
        isPlaying.value = false;
      }
      return;
    }

    isPlayingNext = true;
    isPlaying.value = true;

    const entry = queue.shift()!;
    currentBlobUrl = entry.blobUrl;
    currentIsExternalUrl = entry.isExternalUrl ?? false;

    // Create the Howl lazily — only one <audio> element at a time
    howlCreatedAt = Date.now();
    currentHowl = new Howl({
      src: [entry.blobUrl],
      format: [entry.format === 'mp3' ? 'mp3' : entry.format === 'wav' ? 'wav' : entry.format],
      html5: true,
      onend: () => {
        cleanupCurrentHowl();
        playNext();
      },
      onplay: () => {
        if (!hasPlayedFirst) {
          hasPlayedFirst = true;
          onFirstPlayCallback?.();
        }
      },
      onloaderror: (_id: number, err: unknown) => {
        console.warn('[useWebAudioPlayer] Failed to load audio chunk:', err);
        cleanupCurrentHowl();
        playNext();
      },
      onplayerror: (_id: number, err: unknown) => {
        console.warn('[useWebAudioPlayer] Failed to play audio chunk:', err);
        cleanupCurrentHowl();
        playNext();
      },
    });
    currentHowl.play();

    // Watchdog: detect when Howler's onend didn't fire (iOS audio interruptions,
    // network issues with html5:true + pre-signed URLs). Poll every 1s — if the
    // Howl reports not playing but has progressed past seek=0, the audio ended
    // but onend was missed.
    clearPlaybackWatchdog();
    playbackWatchdog = setInterval(() => {
      if (!currentHowl) {
        clearPlaybackWatchdog();
        return;
      }
      // Grace period: skip checks for 3s after Howl creation.
      // For html5:true with remote URLs, there's a brief window after play()
      // where buffering hasn't started but seek() could be non-zero.
      if (Date.now() - howlCreatedAt < 3000) {
        return;
      }
      const playing = currentHowl.playing();
      const seek = currentHowl.seek();
      const duration = currentHowl.duration();

      // Detect finished audio: either seek progressed past 0 (normal case),
      // or the audio loaded (duration known) but is no longer playing.
      // The duration check catches short WAV files where seek() resets to 0
      // after completion on some browsers.
      if (!playing && (seek > 0 || (duration > 0 && duration < Infinity))) {
        console.warn('[useWebAudioPlayer] Watchdog: onend missed, advancing');
        logTelemetry('TTS playback watchdog: onend missed', { seek, duration });
        clearPlaybackWatchdog();
        cleanupCurrentHowl();
        playNext();
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Ordered chunk buffering (for WebSocket TTS delivery)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * Queue a URL-based chunk for ordered playback.
   * Buffers out-of-order chunks and flushes consecutive ones starting
   * from expectedNextIndex.
   *
   * When `isFinal` is true, `setSynthesizing(false)` is deferred until this
   * chunk is actually flushed to the playback queue — not when it arrives.
   * This prevents out-of-order final chunks from prematurely clearing synthesis state.
   */
  function queueOrderedChunk(
    url: string,
    format: string,
    chunkIndex: number,
    isFinal = false
  ): void {
    if (!acceptsAudio()) return;
    chunkBuffer.set(chunkIndex, { url, format, isFinal });
    // Flush consecutive chunks starting from expectedNextIndex
    let flushed = false;
    while (chunkBuffer.has(expectedNextIndex)) {
      const chunk = chunkBuffer.get(expectedNextIndex)!;
      chunkBuffer.delete(expectedNextIndex);

      // Sentinel chunks (empty URL, isFinal only) signal completion without audio
      if (chunk.url) {
        queueUrl(chunk.url, chunk.format);
      }

      // Only mark synthesis done when the FINAL chunk is flushed to the playback queue
      if (chunk.isFinal) {
        isSynthesizing.value = false;
      }

      expectedNextIndex++;
      flushed = true;
    }

    if (flushed) {
      // Progress was made — clear the watchdog
      clearGapWatchdog();
    }

    // If chunks remain buffered but can't flush (gap exists), start the watchdog
    if (chunkBuffer.size > 0) {
      startGapWatchdog();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Skip a failed chunk and advance the ordered buffer past it.
   * Flushes any subsequently buffered chunks that were waiting behind the gap.
   * Call this from onTtsChunkFailed so the ordering buffer doesn't get stuck.
   */
  function skipOrderedChunk(chunkIndex: number, isFinal = false): void {
    if (chunkIndex === expectedNextIndex) {
      expectedNextIndex++;
      // Flush consecutive chunks buffered after the skipped one
      while (chunkBuffer.has(expectedNextIndex)) {
        const chunk = chunkBuffer.get(expectedNextIndex)!;
        chunkBuffer.delete(expectedNextIndex);
        if (chunk.url) {
          queueUrl(chunk.url, chunk.format);
        }
        if (chunk.isFinal) {
          isSynthesizing.value = false;
        }
        expectedNextIndex++;
      }
    } else if (chunkIndex > expectedNextIndex) {
      // Future chunk failed — buffer it as empty so ordering can advance through it
      chunkBuffer.set(chunkIndex, { url: '', format: '', isFinal });
    }

    if (isFinal) {
      isSynthesizing.value = false;
    }

    // If nothing is queued or playing and synthesis just ended, clear playing state
    if (!isSynthesizing.value && !isPlayingNext && queue.length === 0 && !isStreamMode()) {
      isPlaying.value = false;
    }

    if (chunkBuffer.size > 0) {
      startGapWatchdog();
    } else {
      clearGapWatchdog();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reset ordered chunk state (call when starting a new TTS stream).
   */
  function resetChunkOrder(): void {
    expectedNextIndex = 0;
    chunkBuffer.clear();
    clearGapWatchdog();
    hasPlayedFirst = false;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Stream mode (ElevenLabs PCM / Qwen/Fish WAV) — scheduled via the Web Audio API
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * Begin a PCM stream. Subsequent appendStreamData() calls schedule contiguous
   * AudioBuffers on a running playhead for gapless playback.
   *
   * @param format - chunk format (expected 'pcm')
   * @param sampleRate - PCM sample rate in Hz (defaults to 24000)
   */
  function startStream(format: string, sampleRate = 24000, initialBufferSeconds = 0): void {
    // Clean up any previous stream
    cleanupStream();
    if (!acceptsAudio()) return;

    streamEnded = false;
    streamInitialBufferSeconds = Math.max(0, initialBufferSeconds);
    streamBufferedBeforeStart = 0;
    streamHasStarted = streamInitialBufferSeconds === 0;
    streamPendingBuffers = [];
    isPlaying.value = streamHasStarted;
    streamSampleRate = sampleRate || 24000;

    streamCtx = getPcmContext();

    if (streamCtx) {
      if (streamCtx.state === 'suspended') {
        streamCtx.resume().catch(() => {
          /* best-effort — armAudio() resumes it inside the gesture */
        });
      }
      nextPlayTime = streamCtx.currentTime + (streamInitialBufferSeconds > 0 ? 0.03 : 0);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Decode a base64 PCM chunk (mono, 16-bit signed little-endian) and schedule it
   * for gapless playback immediately after the previously-scheduled audio.
   */
  function appendStreamData(base64Audio: string, sampleRate?: number): void {
    if (!streamCtx) {
      // startStream() wasn't called (or no Web Audio) — nothing to schedule.
      return;
    }

    const rate = sampleRate || streamSampleRate;

    const binaryString = atob(base64Audio);
    const len = binaryString.length;
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
    }

    // Interpret bytes as 16-bit signed PCM, mono. Floor to whole samples in case
    // a chunk boundary ever lands on an odd byte (it shouldn't — chunks are even).
    appendPcmBytes(bytes, rate);
  }

  function appendPcmBytes(bytes: Uint8Array, rate: number): void {
    if (!streamCtx) return;

    // Interpret bytes as 16-bit signed PCM, mono. Floor to whole samples in case
    // a chunk boundary ever lands on an odd byte (it shouldn't — chunks are even).
    const sampleCount = bytes.length >> 1;
    if (sampleCount === 0) return;

    const audioBuffer = streamCtx.createBuffer(1, sampleCount, rate);
    const channel = audioBuffer.getChannelData(0);
    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, sampleCount * 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < sampleCount; i++) {
      // Int16 → Float32 in [-1, 1)
      channel[i] = view.getInt16(i * 2, true) / 32768;
    }

    if (!streamHasStarted) {
      streamPendingBuffers.push(audioBuffer);
      streamBufferedBeforeStart += audioBuffer.duration;
      releaseBufferedStreamIfReady();
      return;
    }

    if (nextPlayTime < streamCtx.currentTime - 0.02 && pendingScheduled === 0 && !streamEnded) {
      logTelemetry(
        'TTS file stream underflow; rebuffering',
        { sample_rate: rate, initial_buffer_seconds: streamInitialBufferSeconds },
        'error'
      );
      streamHasStarted = false;
      isPlaying.value = false;
      streamPendingBuffers = [audioBuffer];
      streamBufferedBeforeStart = audioBuffer.duration;
      releaseBufferedStreamIfReady();
      return;
    }

    scheduleStreamBuffer(audioBuffer);
  }

  function releaseBufferedStreamIfReady(): void {
    if (!streamCtx || streamHasStarted || streamPendingBuffers.length === 0) return;
    if (streamBufferedBeforeStart + 0.001 < streamInitialBufferSeconds && !streamEnded) return;

    streamHasStarted = true;
    isPlaying.value = true;
    nextPlayTime = Math.max(nextPlayTime, streamCtx.currentTime + 0.03);
    const pending = streamPendingBuffers;
    streamPendingBuffers = [];
    streamBufferedBeforeStart = 0;
    for (const queuedBuffer of pending) scheduleStreamBuffer(queuedBuffer);
  }

  function scheduleStreamBuffer(audioBuffer: AudioBuffer): void {
    if (!streamCtx) return;
    const source = streamCtx.createBufferSource();
    source.buffer = audioBuffer;
    source.connect(streamCtx.destination);

    // Never schedule in the past — if the playhead overran (underflow), catch up.
    if (nextPlayTime < streamCtx.currentTime) {
      nextPlayTime = streamCtx.currentTime + 0.03;
    }

    pendingScheduled++;
    scheduledSources.push(source);
    source.onended = () => {
      pendingScheduled--;
      scheduledSources = scheduledSources.filter((s) => s !== source);
      maybeFinishStream();
    };

    source.start(nextPlayTime);
    nextPlayTime += audioBuffer.duration;

    if (!hasPlayedFirst) {
      hasPlayedFirst = true;
      onFirstPlayCallback?.();
    }
  }

  /** Fetch a standalone PCM16 WAV and append its data section to stream mode. */
  function appendStreamUrl(url: string, sampleRate?: number): Promise<void> {
    const generation = streamGeneration;
    streamEnded = false;
    streamUsesUrls = true;
    streamUrlChain = streamUrlChain
      .then(async () => {
        if (generation !== streamGeneration || !streamCtx) return;

        // Keep at most roughly two decoded Qwen chunks scheduled ahead. URLs stay
        // cheap in the promise chain until the Web Audio playhead has capacity.
        while (streamCtx && nextPlayTime - streamCtx.currentTime > 3.1) {
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
          if (generation !== streamGeneration) return;
        }

        const response = await fetch(url);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Audio chunk fetch failed with HTTP ${response.status}`);
        const wav = new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer());
        const parsed = extractWavPcm(wav);
        appendPcmBytes(parsed.pcm, sampleRate || parsed.sampleRate || streamSampleRate);
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        if (generation !== streamGeneration) return;
        logTelemetry('TTS WAV stream fetch/decode failed', { url, error: String(error) }, 'error');
      });

    return streamUrlChain;
  }

  /**
   * Signal that no more PCM chunks will arrive. Playback finishes naturally once
   * the last scheduled buffer ends.
   */
  function endStream(): void {
    if (!streamUsesUrls) {
      finishStreamInput();
      return;
    }

    const generation = streamGeneration;
    void streamUrlChain.finally(() => {
      if (generation !== streamGeneration) return;
      finishStreamInput();
    });
  }

  function finishStreamInput(): void {
    streamEnded = true;
    if (!streamHasStarted && streamPendingBuffers.length > 0) {
      streamBufferedBeforeStart = streamInitialBufferSeconds;
      const pending = streamPendingBuffers;
      streamPendingBuffers = [];
      streamHasStarted = true;
      isPlaying.value = true;
      if (streamCtx) nextPlayTime = Math.max(nextPlayTime, streamCtx.currentTime + 0.03);
      for (const queuedBuffer of pending) scheduleStreamBuffer(queuedBuffer);
    }
    maybeFinishStream();
  }

  /**
   * Clear isPlaying once the stream has ended, all scheduled buffers have played
   * out, and synthesis is no longer in progress.
   */
  function maybeFinishStream(): void {
    if (streamEnded && pendingScheduled <= 0 && !isSynthesizing.value) {
      isPlaying.value = false;
    }
  }

  function getMimeType(format: string): string {
    switch (format) {
      case 'mp3':
        return 'audio/mpeg';
      case 'opus':
        return 'audio/webm; codecs="opus"';
      case 'aac':
        return 'audio/aac';
      case 'wav':
        return 'audio/wav';
      default:
        return 'audio/mpeg';
    }
  }

  function extractWavPcm(wav: Uint8Array): { pcm: Uint8Array; sampleRate: number } {
    if (wav.length < 44 || String.fromCharCode(...wav.subarray(0, 4)) !== 'RIFF') {
      throw new Error('Invalid WAV chunk');
    }

    const view = new DataView(wav.buffer, wav.byteOffset, wav.byteLength);
    const sampleRate = view.getUint32(24, true);
    let offset = 12;
    while (offset + 8 <= wav.length) {
      const id = String.fromCharCode(...wav.subarray(offset, offset + 4));
      const size = view.getUint32(offset + 4, true);
      if (id === 'data') {
        const start = offset + 8;
        return { pcm: wav.subarray(start, Math.min(wav.length, start + size)), sampleRate };
      }
      offset += 8 + size + (size % 2);
    }

    throw new Error('WAV data chunk missing');
  }

  function cleanupStream(): void {
    streamGeneration++;
    for (const source of scheduledSources) {
      try {
        source.onended = null;
        source.stop();
      } catch {
        // already stopped / never started — ignore
      }
    }
    scheduledSources = [];
    pendingScheduled = 0;
    streamEnded = false;
    streamInitialBufferSeconds = 0;
    streamBufferedBeforeStart = 0;
    streamHasStarted = false;
    streamPendingBuffers = [];
    streamUrlChain = Promise.resolve();
    streamUsesUrls = false;
    nextPlayTime = 0;
    streamCtx = null;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Shared controls
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * Whether PCM stream mode is active.
   */
  function isStreamMode(): boolean {
    return streamCtx !== null;
  }

  /**
   * Stop all playback and clear state (both modes).
   */
  function stop(): void {
    // Queue mode cleanup
    hasPlayedFirst = false;
    clearPlaybackWatchdog();

    if (currentHowl) {
      currentHowl.stop();
      currentHowl.unload();
      currentHowl = null;
    }
    if (currentBlobUrl && !currentIsExternalUrl) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(currentBlobUrl);
    }
    currentBlobUrl = null;
    currentIsExternalUrl = false;

    for (const entry of queue) {
      if (!entry.isExternalUrl) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(entry.blobUrl);
      }
    }
    queue.length = 0;

    isPlayingNext = false;

    // Ordered chunk buffer cleanup (resetChunkOrder also clears the gap watchdog)
    resetChunkOrder();

    // Stream mode cleanup
    cleanupStream();

    isSynthesizing.value = false;
    isPlaying.value = false;
  }

  /**
   * Set whether more chunks are expected from the backend.
   */
  function setSynthesizing(value: boolean): void {
    if (value && !acceptsAudio()) return;

    isSynthesizing.value = value;

    // If synthesis just finished and nothing is queued or playing, clear state
    if (!value && !isPlayingNext && queue.length === 0 && !isStreamMode()) {
      isPlaying.value = false;
    }
  }

  function destroy(): void {
    stop();
  }

  /**
   * Update the onFirstPlay callback after construction.
   * Allows persistent instances to receive timing callbacks set later.
   */
  function setOnFirstPlay(callback: (() => void) | undefined): void {
    onFirstPlayCallback = callback;
  }

  /**
   * Update the gap-stall callback after construction (persistent instances wire
   * this from ChatProvider, where the audible cue lives).
   */
  function setOnGap(callback: (() => void) | undefined): void {
    onGapCallback = callback;
  }

  return {
    isPlaying,
    isSynthesizing,
    // Queue mode (Groq/OpenAI and non-progressive providers)
    queueChunk,
    queueUrl,
    // Ordered chunk buffering (WebSocket TTS)
    queueOrderedChunk,
    skipOrderedChunk,
    resetChunkOrder,
    // Stream mode (ElevenLabs PCM / Qwen/Fish WAV)
    startStream,
    appendStreamData,
    appendStreamUrl,
    endStream,
    isStreamMode,
    // Shared
    stop,
    setSynthesizing,
    setOnGap,
    destroy,
    setOnFirstPlay,
  };
}
